digest.component_or_area: outbound parent reconciliation (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path (_map_local_to_jira_fields:145-156) drops a non-epic parent silently with no durable bridge_alerts record, only logger.debug which operators never see
ACLI attach fallback (_attach_parent_guarded:136-143) swallows HTTP 400 rejection of a parent with WARNING and returns, never calling record_parent_divergence, leaving no durable divergence record
Both surfaces violate the project's own contract stated in pass_io.py:113-118 and dispatch_one.py:561-564 that dropped parents must leave a durable operator-visible record, not merely a log line
The suppressed_out parameter mechanism from 9f26 (UPDATE emit fix) must be ported to CREATE emit to judge and report suppressed parents through the existing dropped_field_sink channel

The unconditional epic-only parent guard in outbound_fields.py:145-147 has vendor-specific rationale (Cloud 400s non-epic parent) but is documented as universal, requiring clarification that Data Center also suppresses silently
